title: Custom domain as /domains shows it
caption: platform.tenant_domains.verification_status (DNS) plus tls_status (pending, issued, failed, expired). Re-check queues the checks; Remove deletes the row at once. Sub-domains can only be re-checked (TLS).

states.label: verified
states.detail: Daily re-check; failures counted '2 of 3'. TLS issued on demand by Caddy.

states.label: failed
states.detail: Window passed or 3 failed daily re-checks. Re-check probes the certificate only.

states.label: removed (row deleted)
states.detail: Owners e-mailed without the reason; sub-domain primary again; `tlsask:` cache dropped.

transitions.label: DNS records found (5-min run or Re-check)
